summary: Bind Git feature probes to an explicit repository context

delivery.outcome: Publish Worktrees 0.5.1 with explicit repository context and distinct context failure diagnostics.
nonGoals: No automatic relocation, repair or removal of existing worktrees
No new Git effect implementation in the domain pack

architecture.decision: Probe in an explicit repository cwd without changing global cwd or creating directories; reject unavailable repository context distinctly from missing Git features, ignoring inherited repository selectors.
interfaceChanges: Optional from_worktree argument and --from-worktree CLI; repositoryContextValid and probeError fields.
architecture.rollback: Revert before runtime adoption; inventory never mutates legacy paths, and existing worktrees remain preserved for an explicitly authorized migration.

validation.evidence: 15 conformance tests passed, including explicit context, inherited Git selectors, missing repair flag and old Git.
